newsitem.title: GERMANY: DASA looks at buying Siemens unit.
newsitem.headline: DASA looks at buying Siemens unit.

text.p: The aerospace unit of car maker Daimler-Benz AG said on Monday it was interested in buying the defence electronics business of Siemens AG.

Daimler-Benz Aerospace (DASA) management board member Werner Heinzmann said at a news conference DASA was interested in the Siemens unit as part of a restructuring of the Daimler's defence and civil systems business area.
DASA planned to enter the offer phase with Siemens in the next few weeks, he said.
Heinzmann expected other bids to come from both domestic and foreign competitors, although DASA should have political support for keeping the defence technology in Germany.
Heinzmann said DASA has a clear interest in the Siemens business because it was an "outstanding fit for us".
Siemens' Diehl group, a maker of guided missiles, could be brought together with DASA's own activities in this area. DASA has already had talks with Diehl about cooperation, he said.

Siemens for several months has been looking for a joint venture partner or buyer for the unit, which includes Siemens Plessey in Great Britain. The business has been hurt by reductions in defence spending,
